Chandra, also known as Somasundara, is associated with the emotional human soul, while Soma is associated with the rational mind. The name Mohanasundaram reflects the spiritual connection between the human soul and the divine, symbolizing the victory of the divine over distractions, just as the moon (Chandra) is said to have been defeated by Lord Rama.
